label: PQ-authorized vault transfers enforced by the runtime (local experimental fork)
statusDetail: Fork patches, ML-DSA-65 syscall, pq-vault SBF program and TypeScript client are implemented and unit tested. The fork validator binary has NOT been built on this host: the release build was stopped by a disk guard (free space fell below 1.5 GiB while the separate unmodified validator ledger grew ~100-190 MB/min). No fork validator is running, so no genesis hash and no on-chain transaction signatures exist yet.

fork.head: 31b6fe24b7f3ba7e1289a223f63d3da5380f3cd0

patches.summary: agave-mldsa-verify crate: fips204 =0.4.6 ML-DSA-65 verify, version/length checks, CU cost, NIST ACVP + noble vectors, benchmark

fork.activation: solana-test-validator activates every feature in FEATURE_NAMES at genesis

crypto.algorithm: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204), pure variant, empty context string
crypto.rustCrate: fips204 =0.4.6 (MIT OR Apache-2.0, default-features off, ml-dsa-65 only)
crypto.syscall: sol_mldsa65_verify(version, pk_addr, msg_addr, msg_len, sig_addr) -> u64 (0 = valid)

program.name: pq-vault
program.programIdDerivation: base58(sha256("lattice:program:pq-vault:v1")); loaded at genesis via --bpf-program (immutable, no upgrade authority)
program.sbpf: v0 ELF (cargo-build-sbf 4.0.0-alpha.0, platform-tools v1.52); imports sol_mldsa65_verify, so it cannot load on unmodified Agave

measurements.host: Apple Silicon macOS (darwin 25.6.0), release build, median of 2000 iterations
measurements.calibration: secp256k1_recover syscall costs 25000 CU => 3.670 ns/CU on this host => 29610 CU suggested

agave-mldsa-verify.includes: 15 NIST ACVP ML-DSA-65 sigVer vectors (3 valid, 12 invalid) + 4 noble cross-implementation vectors with mutations

solana-syscalls (mldsa65 filter).includes: feature-gated registration; valid/invalid/short message/unsupported version/oversize/access violation/insufficient CU

pq-vault host tests.includes: valid transfer, replay, tampered amount/expiry/recipient, wrong genesis, bit-flipped signature, wrong key, expiry, insufficient funds, incomplete buffer, out-of-order write, sealed vault, golden message vector

@lattice/crypto vitest.includes: golden message vector shared with Rust, field binding, packet-size packing

stillClassical: Fee payer and every transaction signature: Ed25519
Relayer that stages signature buffers and submits pq-vault transactions: Ed25519 (cannot move vault funds)
Vault account creation: one-time Ed25519 signature by the vault address and setup authority; powerless after SealVault
Validator identity and vote accounts: Ed25519
Votes / consensus (Tower BFT, and Alpenglow BLS where enabled): classical
Gossip, Turbine shreds, repair, QUIC/TLS networking: classical
Program upgrade authority: pq-vault is immutable at genesis; all other upgradeable programs use Ed25519 authorities
Wallets and ordinary system-program accounts: Ed25519
